objectives.name: Production service availability
objectives.definition: Share of successful requests (non-5xx responses to valid requests) out of all valid requests served by the production service through its public entry point, excluding announced maintenance windows.
objectives.measurement_source: Azure Monitor availability metric and Application Insights request telemetry, reported on the platform reliability dashboard
objectives.breach_consequence: Post-incident review within 5 business days and a reliability action plan reviewed by the service owner; repeated breaches in consecutive months pause non-critical feature releases.

objectives.name: API latency (p95)
objectives.definition: 95th percentile server-side response time of interactive API requests, measured at the ingress, excluding long-running asynchronous jobs.
objectives.measurement_source: Application Insights request duration percentiles, Grafana latency dashboard
objectives.breach_consequence: Performance investigation opened as a high-priority backlog item; the owning team reports findings at the next weekly operations review.

objectives.name: P1 incident response time
objectives.definition: Time from the first automated alert or customer report of a priority 1 incident to acknowledgement by an on-call engineer who starts working on it.
objectives.measurement_source: Paging tool acknowledgement timestamps compared with the incident record creation time
objectives.breach_consequence: Escalation to the engineering manager on duty and a review of the on-call rota and alert routing in the post-incident review.

objectives.name: P1 incident restoration time
objectives.definition: Time from the start of a priority 1 incident to restoration of normal service for affected users, whether by fix, rollback or failover.
objectives.measurement_source: Incident record timeline (detected, mitigated, resolved timestamps)
objectives.breach_consequence: Mandatory post-incident review with a written root cause analysis shared with the management team within 5 business days.

objectives.name: P2 incident restoration time
objectives.definition: Time from detection of a priority 2 incident (major degradation with a workaround available) to restoration of normal service.
objectives.measurement_source: Incident record timeline in the service management tool
objectives.breach_consequence: Incident reviewed at the next weekly operations review and a corrective action assigned to the owning team.

notes: These objectives apply to every production application on the platform unless a service owner agrees a stricter target. Free or community tiers of a product carry no contractual commitment. The targets are reviewed once a year by the service owners and the platform management team.
